items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html: (To the question) What is his awakening from his sleep? When ZA rises as MAN to Aba and Ima, then all the aspects of his Mochin ascend there, both the inner Partzuf and the Mochin of VAK, and nothing remains below but the aspect of VAK of Ruach alone. And because of this he is discerned in the secret of slumber and sleep, like a sleeping man whose brains have departed. And after he received the Mochin there in Aba and Ima, he descends to his place, and the Mochin clothe in him; and the clothing of the Mochin in him is called his awakening from his sleep. (Item 127).
